description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'diff-highlight' tool. It defines test cases for diff highlighting, including setup functions, individual tests for highlighting specific diff parts, handling of UTF-8 and combining code points, and graph diff visualizations.

methods.name: dh_test
methods.description: A helper function that runs diff-highlight on two git states and compares output with expected.

methods.name: test_strip_patch_header
methods.description: Removes header lines from diff output, keeping the actual patch content.

methods.name: dh_test_setup_history
methods.description: Sets up a particular git commit history graph for testing diff graph visualization.

methods.name: left_trim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace from input lines.

methods.name: trim_graph
methods.description: Removes graph characters from diff output for comparison.
